task: D1: the ports as the elements of the frame group, and the second index (briefs/TASK_D1.md)
labels: EXACT unless marked; item 6 NOT BLIND

item1_certificate.status: EXACT, integers and Q(sqrt5); all five frames x twelve base ports

statement.group: rotation group of a cubic frame: order 12, simply transitive on the twelve ports (all five frames)
statement.generators: F = exchange of the two ports of each frame seam (right translation by the half-turn about the long axis of the base port); C+ and C- = thirds of a turn of every port inside its face of the first and of the second inscribed tetrahedron (right translations by the thirds of a turn about n+s+l and -n+s+l)
statement.port_space: 1 + 1' + 1'' + 3 x 3: three Klein-invariant functions (on the three golden rectangles) and nine matrix coefficients rho(g_p)_ij
statement.second_action: right translations = the centralizer of the frame rotations in the permutations of the ports (12 elements, canonical as a set). Canonical with names: F, P (antipode), F P, C+, C-. The labelling of the right translations by group elements depends on the base port through conjugation: R_(a p0)(k) = R_p0(a^-1 k a).
statement.kernel_on_second_index: singlets: 5, -1, -1 (A = 2J - 1 on the rectangles). Triplet: M3 = [[-1,0,0],[0,-1,2],[0,2,1]] in the body axes (normal, short, long) of the base port, for every frame and base port. In fixed frame coordinates M3 takes six values (base ports p and P p agree).
statement.commuting_part: of the twelve right translations only the identity and P commute with the kernel
statement.M3_eigenvectors: (0,1,phi): sqrt5, the port itself (slow band); (1,0,0): -1, the normal of the rectangle (triplet inside the quintet); (0,phi,-1): -sqrt5, the conjugate port (fast band)
statement.mixing_angle: tan = 1/phi between the slow eigenvector and the long axis; squared components (1/2+1/10*r5) and (1/2+-1/10*r5)

canonical.second_index_space: the multiplicity space of the frame triplet in the port space; as a subspace of the port space the triplet-isotypic part (rank 9) of the frame group
canonical.kernel_copies: slow = the sqrt5 eigenspace of the adjacency (the 3 of the sixty rotations); fast = the -sqrt5 eigenspace (the 3prime); middle = the 5 of the rotations intersected with the triplet-isotypic part of the frame group. Slow and fast do not depend on the frame; the middle copy depends on the frame and on nothing else
canonical.axis_lines_of_the_second_index: the joint eigenspaces of the right Klein group {1, F, P, FP}: normal line = P-even = the middle copy; long line = F-even; short line = FP-even
canonical.mixing_angle_copies_vs_lines: squared overlaps (5 + sqrt5)/10 and (5 - sqrt5)/10 in the P-odd plane; the middle copy is a line

base_port_dependent.bijection_lines_to_frame_axes: fixed by the golden rectangle of the base port (three cyclic choices per frame)
base_port_dependent.signs: fixed by the base port inside its rectangle
base_port_dependent.matrix_M3_in_frame_coordinates: six values; a coordinate expression of one canonical operator

item2_cover.status: EXACT, Q(zeta_60); 26 checks after the canonical lift of the half-turn

answer.where_the_doublets_occur: 2, 2', 2'' occur (i) twice each in the port space of every odd flux sector; (ii) once each in triplet x doublet: the quark-doublet patterns of the code and every triplet copy of the load space tensored with a spin doublet; (iii) once each in (1 + 1' + 1'') x doublet. They do not occur in the load space, in the public walk or in the five-level code itself (3 + 2).
answer.kernel_on_multiplicity: yes, in every flux sector, by Schur: 2x2 Hermitian matrices on the doublets, a number on each singlet, a 3x3 Hermitian matrix on the triplet
answer.second_index_dimension: three for the triplet (even flux), two for each doublet (odd flux), one for each singlet

M1_anchors_port_diagonal.statement: V = identity for every pair of anchors and every frame; J = 0. Anchors are coordinates of one canonical operator (item 1b).

M3a_consensus_on_triplet.statement: the consensus projector is zero on the triplet second index: no heavy copy, the three copies are degenerate at zero under a consensus mass; the mixing is undefined (any basis)

M3b_consensus_on_singlets.statement: kernel and consensus projector commute on the singlet space: V = 1, J = 0; the consensus projector gives one heavy state (the uniform one) and two massless ones (1prime, 1second)

M4a_frame_axis_on_triplet.statement: kernel copies (slow, middle, fast) against the axis lines ordered (long, normal, short): one angle arctan(1/phi) = 31.717 degrees, two zeros, J = 0; which of the three standard angles carries it follows the order of the lines

M4b_frame_axis_on_singlets.statement: kernel (or consensus projector) on the singlet space against one golden rectangle (a frame axis), completed by the other two rectangles: the three-point Fourier matrix (trimaximal); |J| = 1/(6 sqrt3), the largest value a 3 x 3 unitary allows; the sign of J follows the order of 1prime and 1second

M6_third_of_a_turn_eigenbasis.statement: kernel copies against the eigenvectors of C+ on the second index (eigenvalues 1, w, w^2 in this order)

M5_flux_sectors.gauge: frame gauge: section into the frame cover; for even k the bundle is trivial on the frame cover and the identification of the port spaces of two flux sectors is canonical
M5_flux_sectors.antiunitary_symmetry: P o K (antipode with complex conjugation) commutes with every A_k, k even: J = 0 for every pair
